design_summary: Two interconnected progression systems for TUMU: skill-based leveling where abilities improve through effective use (you get better at what you do, no passive XP), and persistent per-controller profiles that save class preferences, per-class skill XP, and lifetime stats across sessions. Backed by docs/design/leveling_and_profiles.md, which specifies the XP curve, per-skill benefits, the profile JSON schema, creation flow, and pause-menu stat display. Both systems were implemented together and rolled into the v0.9.0 feature milestone.

epics.title: Character Leveling System
epics.source: BACKLOG.md EPIC 12 (progression, classes); docs/design/leveling_and_profiles.md (Leveling System section)
epics.summary: Skill-based leveling where each ability improves through successful use rather than passive XP. Per-skill XP (attack, special, charge, block) levels independently and grants scaling bonuses plus milestone VFX, with an overall character level derived from skill averages granting HP and mana. Implemented 2026-03-14 alongside profiles and folded into the v0.9.0 milestone.

stories.title: XP & Level Framework
stories.summary: Core XP curve, per-player level/xp fields in PlayerManager, and XP gain on hit, kill, and boss defeat with level-up VFX and a cap.

tasks.title: Define XP curve per level (level 1=100xp, level 2=250xp, scaling formula)
Add level and xp fields to player data in PlayerManager
XP earned on successful hit (attack lands on enemy = xp for that skill)
XP earned on kill (bonus xp for finishing blow)
XP earned on boss defeat (large bonus, scales with boss difficulty)
Level-up VFX + sound when threshold reached (gold flash, fanfare)
Max level cap (20 per skill, 50 overall)

stories.title: Per-Skill Leveling
stories.summary: Independent XP tracking for attack, special, charge, and block, each leveling from its own successful use, including class-specific healing and summoning XP.

tasks.title: Track XP separately for: basic attack, special ability, charge attack, block/parry
Each skill levels independently based on successful use
Basic attack: each landed hit grants 1-3 xp (scales with enemy difficulty)
Special ability: each successful use grants 5-10 xp
Charge attack: damage dealt during charge converts to xp (1 xp per 5 damage)
Block: each blocked hit grants 3 xp. Perfect parry grants 15 xp
Healing (Healer): each HP healed on allies grants 0.5 xp
Summoning (Summoner): donut buddy damage contributes xp to summoner

stories.title: Skill Level Benefits
stories.summary: Each skill level grants scaling bonuses (damage, cooldown, charge speed, damage reduction) plus milestone VFX unlocks, surfaced on the pause-menu stat screen.

tasks.title: Each skill level grants a small bonus (attack +2% dmg, special -2% cd/+1% effect, charge +3% speed/+2% dmg, block +1% reduction/+0.02s parry per 5)
Milestone bonuses at levels 5, 10, 15, 20 (unlock new visual effects, sound changes)
Display skill levels on pause menu stat screen

stories.title: Overall Character Level
stories.summary: An overall level computed from the average of skill levels, granting HP and mana, displayed next to the player name and on class-selection slots.

tasks.title: Overall level = average of all skill levels (rounded down)
Overall level grants: +5 max HP per level, +3 max mana per level
Level displayed next to player name (e.g. 'P1 - Melee Lv.7')
Level shown on title screen class selection slots

epics.title: Persistent Profiles & Save System
epics.source: BACKLOG.md EPIC 13 (progression, ui); docs/design/leveling_and_profiles.md (Persistent Profile System section)
epics.summary: Player profiles persisted to a JSON file in user:// that survive crashes and sessions, storing name, ranked class preferences, per-class skill XP and stats, and lifetime stats. Includes a controller-driven creation flow, profile-linked auto class assignment on join, a pause-menu stats display, and management for up to 8 profiles with delete and guest mode. Built 2026-03-14 to 2026-03-18 across the early v0.9.x release run.

stories.title: Profile Storage
stories.summary: JSON save/load via Godot FileAccess in user://, with a per-class profile schema and auto-save on tower completion, boss defeat, and quit to menu.

tasks.title: Save/load system using Godot's FileAccess (JSON file in user://)
Profile data structure: name, class_preferences, per_class_stats, created_date
Per-class stats within profile: level, skill_xp, total_kills, total_muffins, boss_kills
Auto-save after each tower completion and boss defeat
Auto-save on quit to menu
Load profiles on game launch

stories.title: Profile Creation Flow
stories.source: BACKLOG.md Story 13.2; commit 'Profiles bound per-controller, name entry with D-pad grid' (2026-03-14)
stories.summary: A controller-driven choose-or-create flow: name entry with on-screen keyboard, stack-ranking class preferences, optional sub-character naming, and a confirm summary, with profile select showing level and preferred class icon.

tasks.title: When controller connects: show 'Choose Profile' or 'Create New' screen
Create new profile step 1: Enter name (3-16 chars), on-screen keyboard, keyboard typing, name validation
Create new profile step 2: Stack-rank class preferences (drag/reorder, D-pad grab/move/drop)
Create new profile step 3: Optionally name each sub-character per class (skip for defaults)
Create new profile step 4: Accept/confirm screen showing summary
Profile select screen shows existing profiles with level + preferred class icon

stories.title: Profile-Linked Gameplay
stories.source: BACKLOG.md Story 13.3; commit 'Auto-select profile's preferred class when cycling profiles' (2026-03-18)
stories.summary: On join, auto-assign the profile's top available class (falling back through the preference stack), label the player with the profile name, and persist XP/level and lifetime stats per profile.

tasks.title: When player joins (START press), auto-assign their profile's top available class
If preferred class is taken, use next preference in stack-rank
Player label shows profile name instead of 'P1' (e.g. 'Dax - Melee Lv.7')
XP and level progress saved to profile after each session
Track lifetime stats per profile: total playtime, total muffins, bosses defeated

stories.title: Pause Menu - Profile Stats Display
stories.summary: The pause menu surfaces the paused player's profile name, avatar, level and XP bar, per-skill levels, session stats, acquired items, and lifetime stats.

tasks.title: Pause menu shows paused player's profile name + avatar
Show class avatar/icon (character sprite preview)
Show current level + XP bar (progress to next level)
Show per-skill levels (attack, special, charge, block Lv.X)
Show session stats: muffins collected, enemies killed, damage dealt
Show acquired items/artifacts this session
Show lifetime stats from profile (total kills, total muffins, bosses defeated)

stories.title: Multiple Profiles Management
stories.summary: Support up to 8 saved profiles with delete (confirmed), last-used profile memory per controller, and a no-save guest mode.

tasks.title: Support up to 8 saved profiles
Delete profile option (with confirmation)
Profile selection remembers last-used profile per controller
Guest mode: play without a profile (no progress saved, labeled 'Guest')
